Ready to shape strategy where it matters? As a Strategy Consultant (f/m/d), you'll take on real responsibility from your first project - from concept to implementation across industries like Automotive & Batteries, Consumer Packaged Goods, Electronics & Semiconductor, Life Sciences and Power Utilities. Backed by Siemens technologies, you'll solve complex problems where strategy meets the real-world and make your mark both for our clients and within Siemens itself.What we offer you- Attractive remuneration package- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family- Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date- Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvementSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You'll make an impact by- Owning core project modules. Scoping the problem, running quantitative and qualitative analyses, and delivering recommendations your team and client can build on, with real responsibility from your very first project onward.** **- Building AI into the answer, not next to it. Treating agentic systems, industrial copilots, and applied analytics as core components of client demands. You apply critical thinking and human judgment to determine where AI creates measurable value and where it doesn’t, challenging outputs and validating assumptions rather than taking AI-generated answers at face value.- Working directly with decision-makers. Regular exchange with C-level executives and their teams, plus interviews and workshops that surface real disagreement instead of polite consensus.- **Seeing your work go live. **Because implementation sits under the same roof, your recommendations move from slide to pilot to rollout, across our industry units.- Shaping Siemens from within. Alongside client work, you take on transformation topics inside Siemens, a perspective on industrial transformation you won't get from client work alone.This is how you'll win us over- Consulting experience: Minimum two internships at a strategy consultancy, or first professional experience in the field.** **- Academic Excellence: Strong Master's, or MBA with a quantitative or technical core, or from a top business school.** **- AI in practice: AI is embedded in your daily work and problem-solving approach. You instinctively judge where technology creates real business value and where it doesn’t. Hands-on experience with agents, LLM applications, or data products is a big plus.** **- Global Mindset: International exposure gained through studies, internships, or work experience abroad.** **- Analytical skills: Ability to build defensible recommendations on incomplete data and explicitly state underlying assumptions.** **- Languages Proficiency: Fluent German (min. C1) and English (min. C1), both required. Many of our client discussions happen in German, so English alone is not sufficient for this role.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers.With pioneering projects bridging across Siemens’ entire portfolio, customers are enabled to leverage the full value of Siemens technologies. jobs.occupation: Corporate Reservations & Sales Coordinator (all genders) in Berlin (Kaufmännische Fachkraft)
jobs.description: We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.Homaris exists to solve one of the most persistent problems in modern cities: People from abroad need places to live, work, and just feel at home. We build and operate fully digitised serviced apartments across Germany´s major cities – next step: Europe and beyond.And a product vision — the nanopartment® — that reimagines what urban stays can look like in the smallest possible space. Revenue triples within two years — organically. No venture capital. No exit strategy. We are in this for the long run, and we build accordingly. Extraordinary people make this happen - and we're looking for one more.Your RoleYou are the person business customers and corporate partners know by name. You take an enquiry from the first message to a complete, accurate reservation, and you make sure the stay runs as promised.This is not an inbox role. You own the process end to end. You work closely with Sales, Reservations, Revenue and Operations, so every booking is commercially sound, correctly recorded and delivered without friction. Our corporate customers experience one team, and you are the reason why.What You'll DoAnswer with clarity. You respond to guests, business customers and partners quickly, precisely and with a solution in mind.Make the offer, then follow up. You create tailored offers and take them to a decision. You do not wait to be asked twice.Guide the full journey. From reservation through changes, cancellations and invoicing, you are the reference point for every question.Coordinate the details. Special requests reach the right team at the right time. Nothing is lost between departments.Back the Sales team. You handle corporate enquiries, offers and account requests, so Sales can focus on closing.Protect the terms. Rates, codes and company requirements are applied exactly as agreed. Every final booking reflects the commercial conditions.Keep accounts current. Negotiated rates, contracts and account information are accurate and up to date.Own the large bookings. You prepare offers for company stays, apartment contingents and group or high-volume bookings, and you bring them to a close.Keep the data clean. Booking, guest and company data are accurate in every relevant system. Reservation quality is your responsibility.Spot the gap early. You use digital and AI tools to find issues before they become problems.Fix the process, not the symptom. When something slows the team down, you redesign the workflow.Build what scales. You create lightweight templates and workflows that make booking faster, clearer and easier to scale.What Makes You a FitRelevant experience. You have worked in reservations, hotel sales, serviced apartments, hospitality, travel or customer service, and you have a clear drive to learn fast. Corporate, group or business-customer experience is a strong advantage.Composure under pressure. You prioritise several moving requests without losing pace or accuracy. When priorities shift, you stay structured and pragmatic.Commercial confidence. You know rates, offers and booking conditions, and you understand their impact on the business.Fluent communication. You write and speak German and English fluently, in writing and by phone.Tool confidence. You work confidently with reservation, property-management and CRM systems.Curiosity about AI. You already use digital and AI-supported tools to draft, summarise, research and automate, with sound judgement and strict attention to data privacy.Ownership. You see what needs doing and you do it. You challenge existing ways of working and help the team move forward.Presence. You are based in Berlin, or ready to be, and you value working together in person.The EnvironmentHomaris is a company with the maximum of long-term orientation. We don't burn cash to grow fast and sell. We build something real, and we expect the people who join us to want to build it with us — not to optimise for others. The pace is high. The problems are real. The team is small enough that every person matters. We're not always great at seeing and celebrating our wins. But we're working on it — and we'd love your help with that.What We OfferWe define levels by the work you own and the decisions you're accountable for, not by your title or years of experience. Beyond that: we've thought carefully about what people actually need to do their best work and live well — and we've built a benefits package that reflects that. Health, mobility, development, flexibility, and a few perks that come with being in the travel and hospitality business. Not much is missing. We'll walk you through the details when we meet.Next StepsIf this opportunity resonates with you, we’d be glad to learn more about your experience and perspective. Just send us your CV.Questions? Reach out to Natalie at karriere@homaris.de or +49 157 92465807. We value diversity and welcome applications from people of all genders, cultures and backgrounds.About usHomaris is a leading provider of serviced nano-apartments in prime urban locations and is pioneering a new generation of space-efficient apartment concepts with its nanopartment®. With more than 4,500 apartments secured under contract in cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf and Dresden, Homaris ranks among Germany’s leading serviced-apartment brands. The company serves contemporary customer segments, including business travellers, tourists, digital nomads and corporate clients.The Homaris concept is based on the integration of a fully digitalised guest journey with maximum space efficiency, multifunctional design and intelligent space solutions. The nanopartment® is Homaris’s signature product, embodying innovative space efficiency, modern minimalism and a modular design concept that combines living, working and a sense of arrival within a compact footprint. What we are looking forBecome part of Fairmas as a Junior Compliance Coordinator (all genders) and help us build a solid foundation for our information security management system. The role sits at the intersection of compliance, information security, process management, and documentation — coordinating requirements, structuring evidence, and making our processes audit-ready. You will work closely with management, IT, HR, legal, and data protection, acting as a coordinating and documenting function rather than the sole owner of all information security.Location:Based in Berlin | Full-time or part-time | Monday to Friday | Work-life balance guaranteed.Do you have a sharp eye for detail, a talent for turning complex requirements into clear documentation, and a genuine interest in information security and compliance? Do you enjoy staying on top of open tasks, deadlines, and responsibilities across multiple teams?Then Fairmas is the right place for you.What we have in store for you• Balance: No weekend work, no shifts, no overtime.• Appreciation: Fair pay and a safe working environment.• Flexibility: Work remotely and from our modern Berlin office – 3 days/week in the office required.• Understanding: Many of us come from the hotel industry ourselves.• Purpose: Help hotels around the world stay economically successful.• Sustainability: Our offices are eco-friendly and perfectly connected.• Mobility: We subsidize your Deutschlandticket.• Growth: Through team events and personal development – we support what makes you unique.Your background• Foundation: Degree/ background in business law, IT law, business informatics, compliance, quality management, or a related field — or a relevant lateral entry from data protection, audit support, or process management.• Compliance mindset: Ability to read, understand, and translate requirements from standards, contracts, and regulations into tasks and documentation.• Security interest: First exposure to ISO 27001, information security, data protection, or audit processes is a plus• IT fluency: You don’t need to be a sysadmin, but you understand basic IT and security concepts such as user and access management, cloud systems, backup, change management, and incident management, and communicate confidently with technical colleagues.• Writing strength: Excellent written German and English; able to document complex topics clearly, precisely, and in an audit-ready way.• Structure: Systematic, thorough, and reliable — you keep track of open points, deadlines, and responsibilities without being prompted.• Collaboration: Professional and clear communicator with management, IT, legal, HR, and data protection stakeholders.• Discretion: High sense of responsibility when handling sensitive information.• Tools: Experience with tools such as Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, Notion, Excel, or GRC tools is a benefit.• Regulatory knowledge: Basic knowledge of GDPR, IT law, data protection law, or contract review is a plus• Industry background: Experience in a software, SaaS, or IT-oriented company is an advantage.• Employment Eligibility: Must be legally authorized to in Germany.How you make an impact• ISMS Development: Support the setup, structuring, and maintenance of our ISO 27001-compliant information security management system — as a coordinating and documenting function in close exchange with management, IT, HR, legal, and data protection.• Requirements Analysis: Break down ISO 27001 controls, identify gaps, assign responsibilities, and track required evidence.• Documentation: Create, revise, and maintain policies, process descriptions, work instructions, checklists, and audit evidence documents.• Audit Preparation: Compile and organize audit materials; ensure all required evidence is in place and traceable.• Task Tracking: Maintain an up-to-date action and task plan including status, owners, deadlines, and open items.• Risk Management: Assist with gap analyses, risk assessments, and documenting risk treatment measures.• Cross-Team Coordination: Gather information and coordinate with IT, HR, legal, data protection, management, and relevant departments.• Process Documentation: Document security processes such as access management, change management, incident management, backup, vendor management, asset management, and awareness programs.• Follow-Through: Track and close open points from internal reviews, external consultations, audits, and management decisions.• Stakeholder Communication: Prepare clear decision bases and summaries for management and business units.Get in Touch! Ready to Join Us? Send us your CV – feel free to include your earliest possible start date. If you have any questions, reach out to us at hr@fairmas.com – we’re happy to help.You don’t meet every single requirement or have gaps in your resume? No problem!Apply anyway – what matters most to us are your motivation, values, and personality.About usFairmas GmbH and its affiliates is a hotel software company specializing in web-based solutions for financial planning, controlling, and management reporting. Since our founding in 2003 in Berlin, our dedicated team, including hoteliers, IT experts, and professionals from a variety of backgrounds, has been supporting more than 18,000 users across 5,500 hotels worldwide.We take pride in delivering first-class service built on years of experience. At Fairmas, we foster a company culture defined by transparency, mutual respect, and strong team spirit. For us, work-life balance isn’t just a buzzword — it’s essential to maintaining long-term motivation and creativity. We firmly believe that our employees are the driving force behind Fairmas, and their ideas and contributions actively shape our company’s future.
